groups.name: Elective(s)
groups.note: Actuarial/Mathematics Electives: 5 courses from the specified elective list (15 credits), of which 2 courses must be taken from the list of Foundation Electives (List 1) and 3 courses from the list of Advanced Electives (List 2). Students may request to replace MATH 2411 by IEDA 2540, ISOM 2500, or LIFS 3150; and MATH 2421 by ELEC 2600, IEDA 2520 or ISOM 3540. The list for each course is given in 'areas'.
